HOW PHYSICS CREATES A CONIC SECTION: FROM F = ma TO ECCENTRICITY e = 1

Live Values Connected!
Move any slider above to update the numbers in this proof.
1. KINEMATICS → PARABOLA EQUATION x² = 4ay

Take the Vertex V(0, 0) at Rohit's mouth (or apex for angled launch), with +x horizontal forward and +y vertically downward:

(1) Horizontal: a_x = 0 ⇒ x(t) = u_x · t ⇒ t = x / u_x
(2) Vertical (from vertex, u_y = 0, a_y = +g):
y(t) = ½ g t²
(3) Substitute t = x / u_x into y(t):
y = ½ g (x / u_x)² ⇒ x² = (2 u_x² / g) · y
Live: u_x = 6.00 m/s, g = 9.8 m/s² ⇒ x² = 7.35 y
2. IDENTIFYING FOCUS F & DIRECTRIX D a = u_x² / 2g

Compare x² = (2 u_x² / g) y with the standard downward-opening parabola equation x² = 4 a y:

• Latus Rectum Length: 4a = 2 u_x² / g
• Focal Distance: a = u_x² / (2g)
• Vertex V: (0, 0) [Rohit's mouth at t = 0]
• Focus F: F(0, a) = (0, u_x² / 2g) [Below Vertex]
• Directrix Line D: y = -a = -u_x² / (2g) [Above Vertex]
Live: a = 1.84 m | Focus F(0, 1.84m) | Directrix y = -1.84m
3. DEDUCTION OF LOCUS & ECCENTRICITY e = 1 PF / PD = 1

Let P(x, y) be any point on the chewing gum's trajectory where x² = 4ay. Let's compute its distance to Focus F(0, a) and Directrix y = -a:

• Distance to Focus F(0, a):
PF = √[(x - 0)² + (y - a)²] = √[x² + y² - 2ay + a²]
• Substitute x² = 4ay from the trajectory law:
PF = √[4ay + y² - 2ay + a²] = √[(y + a)²] = y + a
• Perpendicular Distance to Directrix line (y + a = 0):
PD = |y - (-a)| = y + a
• Eccentricity: e = PF / PD = (y + a) / (y + a) = 1
At current t: PF = y + a = 2.21 m, PD = 2.21 m ⇒ e = 1.0000!
4. SECRET ENERGY LINK: DIRECTRIX = ZERO-SPEED CEILING! v = √(2g·PD)

Why does the Directrix sit at distance a = u₀²/(2g) above Rohit's mouth? Because u₀²/(2g) is the exact height the gum would reach if thrown straight up with speed u₀!

• Speed of gum after falling vertical distance y:
v² = v_x² + v_y² = u₀² + (gt)² = u₀² + 2gy
• Factor out 2g and recall a = u₀² / (2g):
v² = 2g (u₀²/2g + y) = 2g (a + y) = 2g · PD
• Amazing Result: v = √(2g · PD) = √(2g · PF)
The gum's speed at ANY point P equals the free-fall speed acquired by dropping from rest at the Directrix line!
Live Speed: v = √(2g · PD) = 6.58 m/s
